skill.name: set-up-shopware-chatgpt-ads-conversions-api
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to connect a Shopware 6 sales channel to ChatGPT Ads through the OpenAI Conversions API. Configure marketing consent and verify server-side delivery with a paid test order. Customer matching and campaign bidding are outside the setup scope.
skill.summary: Connect Shopware 6 to ChatGPT Ads and verify server-side conversion delivery with a test order.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most matches are Markdown formatting, vendor links, or integration guidance, not command injection or system reconnaissance. Confirmed risks include authenticated writes, customer order reads, a remote tool connection, and an installer without a pinned release. The workflow also needs stronger credential handling, consent verification before activation, and safeguards for live documentation.

remediation.issue: OpenAI key handling conflicts with the no-chat instruction.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the chat and CLI credential exception. Require users to enter keys only in the verified Product Metrics credential form or an approved secret-entry flow.

remediation.issue: The destination is enabled before the Shopware consent configuration is checked.
remediation.suggestion: Keep sending off until the merchant approves the processor, destination, sales channel, and data fields. Verify that tests without marketing consent produce no delivery.

remediation.issue: The workflow permits authenticated writes and broad order reads.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the tenant and scope before writes. Verify delivery with counts or a user-supplied test order ID, and redact customer fields from results.

remediation.issue: The skill directs agents to a remote tool and falls back to live documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval for the Product Metrics connection and restrict it to needed operations. Use reviewed local references or a pinned snapshot for agent instructions.

remediation.issue: The install command does not pin an installer version or source revision.
remediation.suggestion: Document a reviewed installer version and immutable skill revision. Require the operator to verify the source before running the installation.

semantic_findings.title: Agent Credential Rule Conflicts With No-Chat Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill permits receiving an OpenAI Conversions API key and passing it to a command. The connection guide says never to paste that key into chat. Direct forwarding does not keep a key out of transcripts or tool logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception and the no-chat rule are explicit. The files do not establish a secret-entry mechanism that keeps the key outside the agent conversation.

semantic_findings.title: Event Sending Enabled Before Consent Configuration Is Verified
semantic_findings.description: The Ads setup leaves sending on before the Shopware workflow verifies the consent banner. Consented events can carry hashed contact identifiers, IP addresses, and order data. The setup does not require a negative consent test before activation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The sequence is explicit, and the test only covers consent granted. The guides say consent gates delivery, so no bypass or unauthorized transmission was established.

semantic_findings.title: Live Documentation Can Replace Reviewed Agent Instructions
semantic_findings.description: When local references are missing, the skill tells the agent to use live vendor Markdown in their place. Changed or compromised documentation could alter privileged setup instructions without another marketplace review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback names mutable pages and provides no revision or integrity check. No evidence of malicious content was found in the bundled references.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopware Conversion Tracking for ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: Browser-only tracking can miss paid orders from your Shopware store. Use Product Metrics to connect server-side conversion tracking and check delivery with a test order.
actual_capabilities: Checks Product Metrics setup status and identifies which connection steps remain.
Guides an administrator through pairing one Shopware sales channel with the Product Metrics plugin.
Guides the merchant through creating a pixel key and connecting the destination in Product Metrics.
Explains which consent settings apply to Shopware and supported third-party banners.
Shows how to verify delivery with a paid test order and destination status.
Explains standard conversion events and the requirements for profit and lifetime value events.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro and editor or admin access. The plugin requires Shopware 6.7, PHP 8.2 or later, and active scheduled tasks and message workers.
Each plugin installation covers one sales channel. Shopware and Ads Manager steps require the merchant or an administrator.
Events require marketing consent. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds do not update events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.
This skill does not configure customer matching or change campaign bidding. Consented events can still carry customer identifiers and browser data.

use_cases.title: Connect a Storefront
use_cases.description: Pair one Shopware sales channel, add a ChatGPT Ads destination, and check the first test purchase.

use_cases.title: Investigate Missing Conversions
use_cases.description: Check the paired sales channel, consent banner, test order, and destination status to explain missing purchases.

use_cases.title: Review Data Sharing Before Launch
use_cases.description: Identify the event fields, consent requirements, and administrator steps before enabling production delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to connect my Shopware 6 store to ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics? Give me a checklist without making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my approved Product Metrics property. Tell me which Shopware and Ads Manager steps I still need to complete. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Test Purchase
prompt_templates.prompt: Walk me through verifying one paid test order in my paired Shopware channel. Use only its test order ID or delivery counts. Do not list unrelated orders.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the destination and event fields for my Shopware sales channel. Plan tests for both consent outcomes and browser pixel deduplication. Keep sending off until I approve activation.

output_examples.input: I saved the destination. Why is the validation event not in Ads Manager?
output_examples.output: Saving validates the key and pixel, but the validation event is not stored in Ads Manager. Place a paid test order through the paired channel with marketing consent. Then check delivery in Product Metrics.

output_examples.input: Purchases are arriving, but I do not see profit events.
output_examples.output: Profit events require a complete contribution margin. Check product costs and additional costs in Product Metrics, then place another paid test order. Campaign conversion selection is a separate step in Ads Manager.

best_practices: Check the verified storefront hostname, paired sales channel, Product Metrics property, and Pixel ID before enabling delivery.
Enter the pairing token and Conversions API key only in their approved application forms.
Test with marketing consent granted and denied before enabling production tracking. Use test order identifiers or aggregate delivery counts.
anti_patterns: Pasting a Conversions API key or Shopware pairing token into a chat or tool log.
Enabling event delivery before checking how the actual storefront banner records marketing consent.
Listing recent customer orders when a specific test order or aggregate delivery count is enough.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. Product Metrics Pro and the Shopware plugin connect your sales channel to the OpenAI Conversions API.

faq.question: Can one plugin installation track all sales channels?
faq.answer: No. Each installation pairs with one Shopware sales channel.

faq.question: Where do I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Create the key in ChatGPT Ads Manager. Enter it in the verified Product Metrics connection form, not in chat.

faq.question: What data can ChatGPT Ads receive?
faq.answer: Consented events can include order and product details, hashed contact identifiers, location fields, IP addresses, and browser information. Available fields depend on the event and consent.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the same pixel and matching event name and event ID for deduplication. Cart and checkout events need your developer to pass matching IDs.

faq.question: Will it import past orders or update later refunds?
faq.answer: No. The integration does not import historical orders. ChatGPT Ads accepts events up to seven days old, and later refunds do not revise delivered events.
